description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Locke)] and [Fire Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Locke)
description.text: Fire abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 2 additional times, critical chance =25%/50%/75%/100% after casting 1/2/3/4+ Fire abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Fire Mode II (Locke)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Fire Mode II (Locke)
description.text: Fire abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Fire abilities, grants [Buff Fire 30% (5s)] and [Instant Cast 3] to the user after using Fire abilities

description.name: Buff Fire 30% (5s)
description.text: Increases Fire damage dealt by 30%, cumulable

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3
